question: Jean and Catherine are the maternal aunts of Cinderella. Charles is the husband of Cinderella. Isabella is the mother of mother-in-law of Charles. How is Isabella related to Jean?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6717c511ed0ab8eea0a2e8284a237b041f3362191caea0d54b9b4bd1bf000a2c.png]
